boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations along corridors in Hofstra’s practical off-campus orbit, each paired with one sourced reason to go.

cards.title: Check the Coliseum Calendar
cards.subtitle: Hempstead Turnpike • live events
cards.notes: Review the event calendar first, then use the venue’s directions and designated Gate 20 area when arranging your ride.
cards.short_summary: A nearby arena stop for scheduled concerts, exhibitions, and other ticketed events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Coliseum is located at 1255 Hempstead Turnpike and provides event-specific visitor directions, parking, accessibility, and pickup information.
cards.access_notes: Entry, parking prices, and opening times depend on the scheduled event; consult the event listing before visiting.

cards.title: Trace Long Island’s Flight Story
cards.subtitle: Charles Lindbergh Boulevard • Museum Row
cards.notes: Pair the aircraft galleries with a planetarium show, checking the day’s schedule before choosing a combined ticket.
cards.short_summary: Historic aircraft and a planetarium anchor this Museum Row destination.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s official page lists its Charles Lindbergh Boulevard location, Tuesday–Sunday hours, and separate museum and planetarium admission options.
cards.source_title: Quick Links | Cradle of Aviation Museum
cards.access_notes: The official page lists Tuesday–Sunday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify the planetarium schedule separately.

cards.title: Explore Fourteen Interactive Galleries
cards.subtitle: Davis Avenue at Charles Lindbergh Boulevard • Museum Row
cards.notes: Visit with a child, follow their choice of interactive galleries, and confirm carousel hours separately from museum hours.
cards.short_summary: Hands-on exhibits make this a useful outing for students hosting younger relatives.
cards.evidence_claim: LICM identifies 11 Davis Avenue on Museum Row, fourteen interactive galleries, general admission, and a policy barring adults without children.
cards.access_notes: Adults are not admitted without children; visitors under 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Carousel hours differ.

cards.entity_name: Nassau County Firefighters Museum and Education Center
cards.title: Practice Fire-Safety Skills
cards.subtitle: Davis Avenue • Museum Row
cards.notes: Focus your visit on the interactive safety simulations, then examine the historic firefighting vehicles and equipment.
cards.short_summary: Immersive drills connect practical fire safety with Nassau County firefighting history.
cards.evidence_claim: Nassau County tourism describes interactive fire-safety simulations and displays ranging from horse-drawn steamers to ladder trucks at this Museum Row facility.
cards.source_title: Museum Row Long Island: A Destination for Everyone in the Family
cards.access_notes: Confirm current public hours and admission with the museum before departing; the county lists the facility at 1 Davis Avenue.

cards.title: See the Stadium and Fields
cards.subtitle: Charles Lindbergh Boulevard • Nassau Hub
cards.notes: Check for a public event before going; ordinary field use requires a permit even though the complex opens daily.
cards.short_summary: A county stadium complex used for track, lacrosse, soccer, football, and organized events.
cards.evidence_claim: Nassau County identifies Mitchel as a 49-acre complex at 1 Charles Lindbergh Boulevard with a stadium and fields for several sports.
cards.source_title: Mitchel Athletic Complex | Nassau County, NY
cards.access_notes: The county lists daily hours of 9 a.m. through sunset and states that fields are available by permit only.

cards.title: Walk the Park’s Activity Loop
cards.subtitle: Hempstead Turnpike • East Meadow park corridor
cards.notes: Enter from Hempstead Turnpike and choose one documented feature, such as the fitness trail or accessible playground.
cards.short_summary: A large county park offering defined recreation areas near the campus corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Nassau County documents a Hempstead Turnpike entrance, a fitness trail near Parking Field 2, and multiple playground areas at Eisenhower Park.
cards.access_notes: Individual attractions have separate seasonal schedules and rules; check the county page before selecting an activity.

cards.title: Browse the Indoor Retail District
cards.subtitle: Old Country Road • Garden City shopping corridor
cards.notes: Use the Old Country Road entrance information and consult the center directory before choosing stores or a meal stop.
cards.short_summary: A weather-independent shopping and dining destination served by several NICE bus routes.
cards.evidence_claim: Roosevelt Field’s official page places the center at 630 Old Country Road and documents more than 250 stores plus a bus depot served by multiple NICE routes.
cards.access_notes: Center and tenant hours can differ; consult the official directory and transportation information before visiting.

cards.title: Choose an Indoor Activity
cards.subtitle: Old Country Road • Westbury retail corridor
cards.notes: Scan the current tenant directory for dining or recreation, then confirm that operator’s hours and booking rules directly.
cards.short_summary: Dining, home retail, and family entertainment share a repurposed Old Country Road complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Samanea’s official site identifies 1500 Old Country Road as a 750,000-square-foot shopping, entertainment, and dining destination.
cards.access_notes: The center advises visitors to contact individual tenants for their specific hours; activity pricing varies by operator.

cards.entity_name: Joysetta & Julius Pearse African American Museum of Nassau County
cards.title: Study Black Long Island History
cards.subtitle: North Franklin Street • Hempstead village corridor
cards.notes: Check the rotating exhibition program, then allow time for the museum’s Black music collection and local-history material.
cards.short_summary: Rotating art and history exhibitions document Black life on Long Island and beyond.
cards.evidence_claim: Nassau County states that the museum at 110 North Franklin Street presents rotating exhibits, screenings, lectures, workshops, and a large Black-music record collection.
cards.source_title: African American Museum and Center for Applied Art | Nassau County, NY
cards.access_notes: The county lists Tuesday–Friday noon–8 p.m., Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m., Monday by appointment, and $5 admission.

cards.title: Pick a Recreation Facility
cards.subtitle: Greenwich Street • Hempstead village corridor
cards.notes: Choose a listed court, field, playground, or picnic area and contact village recreation about program or facility rules.
cards.short_summary: A village recreation complex with indoor rooms, outdoor fields, courts, and a playground.
cards.evidence_claim: The Village of Hempstead lists Kennedy Memorial Park at 335 Greenwich Street with courts, fields, a gym, picnic areas, a playground, and other facilities.
cards.source_title: Kennedy Memorial Park | Village of Hempstead
cards.access_notes: The village FAQ lists park hours of 9 a.m.–9 p.m. weekdays and 9 a.m.–5 p.m. weekends; programs may have separate rules.
